help.title: How it works 💗
help.private: This link is just for you. Please don't share it with anyone – whoever has it can see and change your numbers.
help.intro: Hi Anna! Here's a short guide to what each page does. You can't break anything – every entry can be changed or deleted at any time.
help.dashboard.title: Overview
help.dashboard.text: At the top you see what comes in this month (income), what leaves automatically (fixed costs) and what you set aside. "Free to spend" is what's left – that's how much you can spend this month. The bar shows how much of it is already gone: green is fine, yellow is getting tight, red means you're over.
help.income.title: Income
help.income.text: Recurring income arrives every month, for example a salary or support payments. One-time income is a gift, a sale or a refund. Tap "Add", enter the amount and the account – done.
help.fixed.title: Fixed costs
help.fixed.text: These are costs that are the same every month: rent, electricity, phone, subscriptions. If an amount changes, just enter the new one – past months stay as they were. Paused entries don't count.
help.variable.title: Expenses
help.variable.text: Everything else you spend: groceries, cinema, clothes. Give it a name, the amount, a category and the account. The overview immediately shows how much of your budget is left.
help.debts.title: Debts
help.debts.text: The top list is what you owe others, the bottom list is what others owe you. With installments you can record how many are already paid – the app then only shows the rest. Once everything is settled, tap the tick.
help.savings.title: Savings
help.savings.text: Every month the app automatically sets something aside – either a percentage of your income or a fixed amount. You choose this under "Monthly set-aside"; the money moves from the chosen account to your savings account. If you need some of it, use "Spend from savings" – that comes out of your savings, not out of this month's budget.
help.accounts.title: Accounts
help.accounts.text: Enter once how much was in each account and on which day that was true. From then on the app adds or subtracts every transaction. That way you can compare the balance with your banking app at any time.
help.history.title: History
help.history.text: Browse through past months here. You see what came in, what went out, what you set aside and what was left over. Below that are all transactions of the month, day by day.
help.settings.title: Settings
help.settings.text: Language, categories and the savings rule. You can also see here whether your data is saved permanently.
onboarding.title: First-time setup ✨
onboarding.intro: Five short steps and everything is ready. I'll guide you page by page – you can pause at any time, your progress is saved.
onboarding.step.accounts.title: Enter account balances
onboarding.step.accounts.text: Open your banking app and, for each account (pencil icon), enter the balance it shows right now plus today's date. 0 € is a valid balance too.
onboarding.step.accounts.status: {n} of {total} accounts with a starting balance
onboarding.step.income.title: Recurring income
onboarding.step.income.text: Add everything that comes in every month – salary, support payments, child benefit – with amount, account and the day it arrives.
onboarding.step.fixed.title: Enter fixed costs
onboarding.step.fixed.text: Add everything that leaves automatically every month: rent, electricity, phone, insurance, subscriptions. Your last bank statements are the best place to look.
onboarding.step.debts.title: Enter debts
onboarding.step.debts.text: Do you owe someone money, or has someone borrowed from you? Add it – with installments, also how many are already paid. Nothing open? Just continue.
onboarding.step.savings.title: Check the savings rule
onboarding.step.savings.text: Decide how much to set aside every month: a percentage of your income or a fixed amount. Also check which account the money is taken from and which savings account it goes to.
onboarding.done.title: All set 🎉
onboarding.done.text: From now on you only need to record your expenses. The overview always shows how much is still free this month – and the balances can be compared with your banking app at any time.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome, Anna! 🌸
onboarding.welcome.text: Let's set up the app together – in five short steps: balances, income, fixed costs, debts and the savings rule.
